purpose: The eight shared escalations as one deterministic table, the release-input classification that gates them, and the state of each correction.
howTheyWereConsumed: By lineage, not by import. All five commits are ancestors of this branch's head — this is the lane that produced them — so there is nothing to cherry-pick and no risk of importing a partial view of a record this branch already carries whole.

releaseInputClassification.verdict: All correction paths are outside both sets. Proceed on this branch; no rebuild, no republication, and Gate A Preview and payment acceptance are untouched by construction.
releaseInputClassification.whyThisHolds: The Dockerfile copies scripts/rcap-render-worker.mjs, scripts/lib/ and src/. Neither scripts/lib/ nor src/ contains any reference to scripts/rcap-official-forms/, so the corrected modules are not reachable from the image even transitively — they run at build time in this repository, not inside the worker.

escalations.currentDefect: decideBinding() receives { name, pdfType, effectiveLabel } and effectiveLabel is undefined for every field of every family, so `subject = effectiveLabel ?? name` resolves to the internal AcroForm field name. Widget rects are captured into field-census.json and never passed. Geometry is not an input to protection.
escalations.requiredBehaviour: The widget rect and the printed caption above it are inputs to decideBinding, and a binding whose rect falls inside a court-owned page region is refused whatever the field is called.
escalations.reviewerConditionFailed: protection established by geometry where required, not label alone
escalations.smallestSharedCorrection: The widget rect and the printed caption above it are inputs to decideBinding, and a binding whose rect falls inside a court-owned page region is refused whatever the field is called.
escalations.familyOwnedFollowUp: re-derive each field map and re-render; the maps are generated, so no family file is hand-edited
escalations.mutationThatMustTurnRed: Rename a protected field to an innocuous name and re-derive: the binder must still refuse it on geometry.
escalations.whyNoFamilyCorrectionSubstitutes: The field maps are generated. A hand-edited map is overwritten by the next re-derivation, and hand-editing 20 of them would leave the defect live for every family added afterwards.

escalations.currentDefect: NEVER_WRITE is { prohibited, protected, signature, court_or_agency, outside_party }. `manual` is absent from both sets, so a field the classifier declined to classify can still be bound and written, and the verifier carries the identical omission so it cannot catch what the binder allowed.
escalations.requiredBehaviour: `manual` is in NEVER_WRITE in both the binder and the verifier.
escalations.reviewerConditionFailed: every discovered entry classified exactly once, and no participant value written to a protected area
escalations.smallestSharedCorrection: `manual` is in NEVER_WRITE in both the binder and the verifier.
escalations.familyOwnedFollowUp: re-render; any binding onto a `manual` field disappears on its own
escalations.mutationThatMustTurnRed: Classify a field `manual` and bind it: the binder must refuse, and the verifier must fail if it did not.
escalations.whyNoFamilyCorrectionSubstitutes: The classification is correct — the field really is manual. What is wrong is that `manual` is not treated as unwritable, which is one constant in shared code.
escalations.correctedBy: `manual` added to NEVER_WRITE in the binder and to NEVER_WRITE_CLASSES in the verifier, kept identical

escalations.currentDefect: PROTECT_RULES carries no SSN pattern, so a Defendant's SSN box is an ordinary writable field and takes the participant's full legal name.
escalations.reviewerConditionFailed: court, clerk, judge, prosecutor, agency, signature, service, notarization and decision fields protected
escalations.familyOwnedFollowUp: re-render KY aoc-334, aoc-496, aoc-496-2 and confirm the SSN and Jail ID boxes are empty in the bytes
escalations.mutationThatMustTurnRed: Offer full_legal_name to a field named `Def.VitalStats.SSN`: it must be refused.
escalations.whyNoFamilyCorrectionSubstitutes: Three families hit this today and every future family with an SSN box hits it tomorrow. A local refusal in three field maps leaves the rule missing.
escalations.correctedBy: a government_identifier protect rule covering SSN, SID, FBI number, jail and booking identifiers, DOC number and driver's licence

escalations.currentDefect: Descriptor matchers are positive-only. street_address matches a City box and a bank-name box; full_legal_name matches an attorney-name line and a street line. The first pattern that hits wins, so the address prints twice and the petitioner is named as their own attorney.
escalations.requiredBehaviour: Descriptors carry refuseWhen guards: street_address declines city/state/zip subjects, full_legal_name declines street and bank subjects.
escalations.smallestSharedCorrection: Descriptors carry refuseWhen guards: street_address declines city/state/zip subjects, full_legal_name declines street and bank subjects.
escalations.familyOwnedFollowUp: re-render the eight affected families; the duplicated address lines and the bank-name fills clear with the binding
escalations.mutationThatMustTurnRed: Offer street_address to a field named `Def.Address.City`: it must be refused rather than matched.
escalations.whyNoFamilyCorrectionSubstitutes: The guard belongs to the descriptor, which is shared. Eight families would each need the same local exception.
escalations.correctedBy: refuseWhen guards on street_address and full_legal_name, and the attorney rule extended to `atty` and `vsb`

escalations.currentDefect: The service_block protect rule matches /certificate\s*of\s*service/ against the field NAME, while deterministic.filing_date matches /cert\s*date/. A field called certDate under a printed 'Certificate of Service' heading is therefore filled by the platform, producing a half-completed sworn certification of service dated by a system that does not know when service occurred.
escalations.requiredBehaviour: service_block fires from the block's printed heading, or cert-date is removed from the filing_date matcher.
escalations.smallestSharedCorrection: service_block fires from the block's printed heading, or cert-date is removed from the filing_date matcher.
escalations.familyOwnedFollowUp: re-render AK tf-800 and tf-805 and confirm the certification line is blank
escalations.mutationThatMustTurnRed: Offer filing_date to `certDate` under a service heading: it must be refused.
escalations.whyNoFamilyCorrectionSubstitutes: This is a sworn statement. A per-family suppression that a re-render can undo is not an acceptable control for it.
escalations.correctedBy: `cert date`, `cert time` and `certify on` added to the service_block rule

After flattening, variants that JavaScript used to show and hide all render at once, overlapping, covering the court's own printed words, and unfilled dropdowns keep their prompt text ('Choose the court') as ink on a filed pleading.
escalations.requiredBehaviour: Exactly one field per caption slot is bound and the rest refused; an unfilled dropdown's prompt is suppressed at flatten.
escalations.reviewerConditionFailed: no clipping, no silent truncation, no duplicated preprinted caption
escalations.smallestSharedCorrection: Exactly one field per caption slot is bound and the rest refused; an unfilled dropdown's prompt is suppressed at flatten.

escalations.requiredBehaviour: The printed label is captured into effectiveLabel and matched.
escalations.smallestSharedCorrection: The printed label is captured into effectiveLabel and matched.

escalations.whyNoFamilyCorrectionSubstitutes: explicitFieldMappings for 15 numbered fields is exactly the local workaround the freeze forbids, and it is the same missing channel as ESC-GEOMETRY-NOT-AN-INPUT seen from the other side.
escalations.note: the same missing channel as ESC-GEOMETRY-NOT-AN-INPUT, seen from the other side: with no printed label reaching the binder, a form whose fields are named as bare digits refuses everything

escalations.currentDefect: 0 of 27 committed sidecars carry the 20 fields the shared contract requires; 12 fields are null in a typical one. The contract's verifier proves its P-block against a sidecar it synthesises from a canary and never opens a committed one, so nothing had compared them.
escalations.requiredBehaviour: The provenance module emits all 20 fields, and the contract verifier reads a committed sidecar.
escalations.smallestSharedCorrection: The provenance module emits all 20 fields, and the contract verifier reads a committed sidecar.
escalations.familyOwnedFollowUp: re-render every family; the sidecar is emitted by the shared module, not written per family
